modelDescription: Made by Weihrauch Revolver, a leading German firearms manufacturer known worldwide for their precision engineered sporting products, the Bounty Hunter has a long and reputable history here in the United States. The Bounty Hunter is a traditional 6-shot revolver with traditional resting notch, and it also has a transfer bar and recessed chambers for safety.  Available in several finish choices and caliber options; 22LR / 22WMR, .357 Mag, .44 Mag and 45 LC. The Bounty Hunter is the best performing and most affordable choice for your Cowboy Action Shooting fun.
